name: Security Scanner Default Preset (DIVZ Dividend) + 2026-05-18 Data Refresh
description: Update the Security Scanner page defaults to match Andrew's DIVZ-style dividend-tilted 13-factor preset across the Russell 1000 universe, and refresh the production S3 data with the 2026-05-18 FactSet vintage. Default on first load: universe=Russell 1000 (wt_iwb), ranking method=non-sector neutral (across entire universe; sector-neutral toggle ships as disabled 'Coming soon' v0.1 placeholder), 13 factor codes with explicit weights summing to 100% across 4 user-facing groups (Dividend 40%: dy_ntm 20 + dps_gr_1yr 10 + shldr_yield 10; Momentum 30%: eps_est_rev_45d + short_pct_chg_12m + days_to_cover + pcta52wl + ret_mom_252d + velocity_63d at 5 each; Value 15%: ey_ntm 7.5 + fcfy 7.5; Quality 15%: accruals_bs 7.5 + leverage 7.5). Data refresh: place attached Screening_DIVZ_IDVZ_20260518.xlsx at s3://opal-data-portal-v2/security_scanner/uploads/2026-05-18/ to trigger the existing opal-security-scanner-processor Lambda (no code/Terraform change; production-shipped under SSCN_PORTAL 2026-03-10). Empirical readiness verified at PRD time: all 13 Andrew signals present in the bundled factor_metadata_registry.json (284 factors total); attached XLSX is structurally compatible with Lambda's header=4 read (header row 5 = 'ticker'; 3,017 rows total, ~3,012 effective data rows after blank-row filter); registry covers required FactSet signal codes with relationship field per signal; current production data stale since 2026-03-06 (LastModified on json/security_scanner/latest/factor_metadata.json).
